name: Rauno Freiberg
role: Staff design engineer · Vercel · interaction craft
bio: Rauno Freiberg is an Estonian interaction designer and Staff Design Engineer at Vercel. His public site rauno.me collects craft notes, Field Notes, and projects including Devouring Details and work toward a History of Software Design exhibit. He writes about invisible details of interaction design and the discipline of making interfaces fast, consistent, and carefully finished.
highlights: Staff Design Engineer at Vercel; public craft site at rauno.me.
Catalogued techniques from Designing Depth (layered composition + motion choreography).
Known for detail-obsessed interaction writing; projects include Field Notes and History of Software Design.
